content.short: Checkpoint Loading is a Web3 media brand using games, metaverse content, and blockchain engagement tools.
content.description: Checkpoint is a metaverse content pioneer that empowers us all to use video games for good. A digitally-interactive media brand with an already accessible metaverse, Checkpoint creates engaging content that explores how video games impact society, culture, education and politics. By leveraging an innovative Engage-to-Earn model, Checkpoint is driving the change in how content is delivered, consumed and distributed across the blockchain, Web 3 and the metaverse for players and creators worldwide.
content.meta: Checkpoint Loading uses Web3 media and metaverse content to connect gaming culture with blockchain. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
